variant_decisions.evidence: ASV reads simply 'I have done as thou hast commanded me', with no quantifier. The qere כְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר carries כֹל and the ASV renders that phrase elsewhere as 'according to all that'; the bare 'as' answers to the ketiv כאשר. The absence of 'all' in the English distinguishes the ketiv.
